title: Požadovaná relace vs. povrchová forma

terminology.task: Operacionalizovaná požadovaná relace: hlavní město nebo oficiální měna.
terminology.strong_claim: Reprezentace se organizuje podle požadované relace i po kontrole bezprostředního výstupního cíle.

baseline.definition: Median of all different-country distances whose two states share family, truth value, relation and one of that family's primary-index forms; pooled over relation and primary form, estimated separately for every family, truth value, layer and position.
baseline.country_pairs: all unordered pairs of distinct locked countries
baseline.invalid_if: zero or non-finite from L1 onward
baseline.analysis_scope: L1-L32; L0 is persisted only as an embedding sanity check

factorial_decomposition.analysis_scope: L1-L32 at both stored positions; the descriptive primary map is L9-L24 at response_boundary
factorial_decomposition.noncommuting_share: (SS_RF + SS_CRF) / (SS_R + SS_F + SS_CR + SS_CF + SS_RF + SS_CRF)

design.primary_window_rationale: L9-L24 is the central half of the 32 decoder blocks and was fixed before inspection of these residuals.
design.bootstrap_interpretation: Descriptive stability to the composition of this locked purposive country set; not population inference over countries.
design.numeric_audit_role: The three-country BF16 audit is descriptive and cannot alter the primary support decision.

generative_forms.g2_question: Odpovědí na otázku „Jaké je hlavní město {country_genitive}?“ je
generative_forms.g3_lexical_holdout: Pokud hledáme státní metropoli {country_genitive}, odpovědí je

generative_forms.g2_question: Odpovědí na otázku „Jaká je oficiální měna {country_genitive}?“ je
generative_forms.g3_lexical_holdout: Pokud hledáme peněžní jednotku {country_genitive}, odpovědí je

preregistered_analysis.primary_structural_quantity: Primární strukturální veličinou je rozklad reprezentačního rozptylu podle faktorů úlohy, formy a country_item po vrstvách; měří se, které efekty se skládají aditivně a které vytvářejí interakci.
preregistered_analysis.structural_question: The balanced factorial map asks what composes with what. Relation-by-form and country-item-by-relation-by-form interaction energy operationalizes failure of additive closure; it does not by itself prove algebraic commutativity of learned operators.
preregistered_analysis.primary_index: For each country, layer, position and truth stratum: A is the mean cosine distance between capital and currency within the same primary form; W is the mean cosine distance between different primary forms within the same relation; I=A-W and J=I/B.
preregistered_analysis.normalization: B is the pooled condition-matched different-country median defined in design.baseline. Verification uses separate B for true and false.
preregistered_analysis.aggregation_order: Compute J per country/layer/(truth); average true and false equally within verification; average L9-L24 within country; only then summarize the ten country values.
primary_predictions: The mean normalized middle-layer index over g1_predicate and g2_question is positive in the generative family.
The mean normalized middle-layer index is positive in the verification family after conditioning on the same truth value and therefore the same immediate output label.
The capital-vs-currency direction estimated from g1_predicate and g2_question aligns positively with the held-out g3_lexical_holdout direction.
preregistered_analysis.support_rule: G and V pass only if their country mean is positive, the lower bound of the 95% percentile country bootstrap interval is above zero, and every leave-one-country-out mean is positive. Alignment passes only if its grand cross-fit mean and every outer country-deletion mean after refitting all remaining cross-fits are positive; its naive country bootstrap and sign-flip are conditional diagnostics because fitted directions overlap. Strong support requires G, V and alignment to pass their respective rules.
secondary_analyses: Balanced seven-component variance decomposition and its descriptive relation-by-form noncommuting share; no post-hoc support threshold is attached to this map.
Country-level percentile bootstrap interval, leave-one-country-out range and exact one-sided sign-flip diagnostic.
Descriptive sign at country_end; it is not a replication because available syntax differs across forms at that position.
Separate early, middle and late profiles without a preregistered inverted-U claim.
Sensitivity subset based on expected first-token rank; the complete locked set remains primary.
Residual norms and token-position differences are reported separately.

exclusion_rules: No country is excluded from the primary analysis because the model answers incorrectly.
A factual ambiguity discovered before residual inspection may replace a country only before the protocol is relocked.
A non-unique country span, a non-identical final boundary token, NaN, zero norm or incomplete state invalidates the whole balanced country block for the affected analysis.
A tokenizer, runner, protocol or model fingerprint mismatch invalidates the run.
Knowledge-qualified results are sensitivity analyses and never replace the complete primary result.
interpretation_limits: Different requested relations must be signalled by some lexical material; lexical influence cannot be removed completely.

The generative family confounds relation with answer identity and answer class: capitals are mainly proper names while currencies are mainly common multi-token expressions. The verification family is therefore necessary, not optional.
Different forms necessarily change length, syntax and contextual position. The second anchor and diagnostics constrain this problem but do not erase it.
Residual similarity indicates representational invariance, not a localized substance called meaning.
L0 is a sanity check, not part of the primary claim.
No tuned lens, steering or role-playing is part of this protocol.
The ten countries are a locked purposive set, not a random sample. Bootstrap intervals describe stability to this set's composition and do not support population inference.
The country_item factor conflates lexical realization, factual identity and other country-specific structure; it is not an independently randomized pure lexicon factor.
The commutation score is a normalized additive-closure diagnostic on residual geometry, not evidence that two learned internal operators commute in the algebraic sense.
The strongest warranted wording is that relation-associated geometry is stable across the locked paraphrases; the protocol cannot prove representation independent of lexical surface.
